questions.question_text: Swadharma, gnān, vairāgya ane māhātmya-gnān teṇe sahit je Bhagwānnī bhakti teṇe yukt evā je Bhagwānnā ekāntik sādhu tenā prasang thakī bhāgwat dharmanu poshaṇ thāy chhe ane vaḷī jīvne mokshanu je ________ te paṇ evā sādhunā prasang thakī ughāḍu thāy chhe.
questions.explanation: According to Vach.Ga.Pr.54, jīvne mokshanu je dwar te paṇ evā sādhunā prasang thakī ughāḍu thāy chhe.

questions.question_text: Pote kūtrā jevo kāmī hoy te ________ thāy ane jo moṭāpurushne viṣhe kāmīpaṇāno dosh paraṭhe to game tevo niṣhkāmī hoy toy paṇ atishay kāmī thāy.
questions.explanation: According to Vach.Ga.Pr.58, Pote kūtrā jevo kāmī hoy te niṣhkāmī thāy ane jo moṭāpurushne viṣhe kāmīpaṇāno dosh paraṭhe to game tevo niṣhkāmī hoy toy paṇ atishay kāmī thāy.

questions.question_text: Ane jo moṭāpurushne atishay niṣhkāmī, nirlobhī, nihswādī, nirmānī, ________ samaje to pote paṇ e sarva vikārthī rahit thaī jāy ane pāko haribhakt thāy.
questions.explanation: According to Vach.Ga.Pr.58, Ane jo moṭāpurushne atishay niṣhkāmī, nirlobhī, nihswādī, nirmānī, nihsnehī samaje to pote paṇ e sarva vikārthī rahit thaī jāy ane pāko haribhakt thāy.

questions.question_text: Je trīs lakshaṇe yukt sant hoy tene viṣhe ________ ne devbuddhi rākhīne man-karma-vachane eno sang kare, to e sangnā karnārāne viṣhe paṇ e trīs lakshaṇ āve chhe.
questions.explanation: According to Vach.Ga.Pr.78, Je trīs lakshaṇe yukt sant hoy tene viṣhe gurubuddhi ne devbuddhi rākhīne man-karma-vachane eno sang kare, to e sangnā karnārāne viṣhe paṇ e trīs lakshaṇ āve chhe.

questions.question_text: Satpurushne viṣhe ________ e ja ātmadarshannu sādhan chhe ane satpurushno mahimā jāṇyānu paṇ e ja sādhan chhe ane Parameshwarnu sākshāt darshan thavānu paṇ e ja sādhan chhe.
questions.explanation: According to Vach.Va.11, Satpurushne viṣhe dṛuḍh prīti e ja ātmadarshannu sādhan chhe ane satpurushno mahimā jāṇyānu paṇ e ja sādhan chhe ane Parameshwarnu sākshāt darshan thavānu paṇ e ja sādhan chhe.

questions.question_text: Satpurushnī āgnāne viṣhe varte chhe te ja ________ varte chhe.
questions.explanation: According to Vach.Ga.Ma.51, Satpurushnī āgnāne viṣhe varte chhe te ja ātmasattārūpe varte chhe.

questions.question_text: Moṭāpurushno jem jem guṇ grahaṇ karto jāy tem tem enī ________ vṛuddhi pāmtī jāy.
questions.explanation: According to Vach.Ga.Ma.51, Moṭāpurushno jem jem guṇ grahaṇ karto jāy tem tem enī bhakti vṛuddhi pāmtī jāy.

questions.question_text: Trīs lakshaṇe yukt evā je sant teno je sang te ________ karīne rākhe, to jeṭlā kalyāṇne arthe sādhan chhe teṭlā sarve tenā sangmā āvī jāy chhe.
questions.explanation: According to Vach.Va.4, Trīs lakshaṇe yukt evā je sant teno je sang te man-karma-vachane karīne rākhe, to jeṭlā kalyāṇne arthe sādhan chhe teṭlā sarve tenā sangmā āvī jāy chhe.

questions.question_text: Santnā ________ Naimishāraṇya kshetra jyā dekhāy tyā kalyāṇne ichchhavu ane tyā ati dṛuḍh man karīne rahevu.
questions.explanation: According to Vach.Sā.7, Santnā samāgamrūp Naimishāraṇya kshetra jyā dekhāy tyā kalyāṇne ichchhavu ane tyā ati dṛuḍh man karīne rahevu.

questions.question_text: Jevo sānḍh hoy tevu vāchharu āve ane jevo ghoḍo hoy evu vachheru āve, tem ja jevā guru maḷe evu ________ āve.
questions.explanation: According to Swa. Vato: 2/10, Jevo sānḍh hoy tevu vāchharu āve ane jevo ghoḍo hoy evu vachheru āve, tem ja jevā guru maḷe evu shishyamā daivat āve.
